workflow.name: archon-forge-check
workflow.description:
Check that the pack's forge plugin can act for this checkout, without
starting any delivery. It runs the check the pack's forge-using workflows
run as their first node, with the env a run gets. The installed plugin must
advertise every operation the delivery workflows use; the merge queue checks
its own when it starts. One repository the checkout's remotes name must
answer an authenticated read. That proves read access,
not write access. A pass names the credential source used; a refusal says
what to fix.

Use when: setting up the pack on a checkout, installing or updating the
forge plugin, or a delivery run refused at its forge node.
NOT for: proving write access (the first write does that).
